import pandas as pd
meta = pd.read_csv('analysis/linked_data/sample_metadata.csv.gz')
pheno = pd.read_csv('analysis/integrated_analysis/phase1_phenotype/strain_phenotype_table.csv')

muc_pheno = pheno[pheno['species']=='Rhodotorula mucilaginosa']
print('mucilaginosa in phenotype table:', len(muc_pheno))

muc_meta = meta[meta['Species']=='Rhodotorula mucilaginosa']
print('mucilaginosa samples in MS metadata:', len(muc_meta), 'unique strains:', muc_meta['canonical_strain'].nunique())

overlap = set(muc_meta['canonical_strain']) & set(muc_pheno['strain_id'])
print('overlap (both MS + canonical phenotype):', len(overlap))

# genome coverage for mucilaginosa (for optional strain-level tree blocking)
gmap = pd.read_csv('analysis/integrated_analysis/phase1_phenotype/genome_strain_species_busco_map.csv')
muc_genome = gmap[gmap['species']=='Rhodotorula mucilaginosa']
print('mucilaginosa with genome/tree tip:', len(muc_genome))
